sources.entry: Think Stats: Exploratory Data Analysis in Python by Allen B. Downey

summary.name: Think Stats 2e
summary.one_liner: Think Stats (2nd edition) is a free, Creative Commons-licensed book by Allen B. Downey that introduces probability and statistics to Python programmers through real-data case studies.
use_cases: learn probability and statistics using Python
explore real datasets with simple techniques
run statistical experiments with short programs
work through NIH dataset case studies
study exploratory data analysis in Python
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Think Stats as an introduction to probability and statistics aimed at readers with basic Python skills. It emphasizes simple techniques for exploring real data sets and answering questions with them. The book includes case studies using datasets from the National Institutes of Health and other sources. Many exercises use short programs to run experiments and build understanding. The page notes the book is available under a Creative Commons license allowing copying, distribution and modification with attribution and no commercial use. Code examples and solutions are in a linked GitHub repository.
notable: Free under Creative Commons license (attribution, non-commercial)
Case studies using NIH and other real datasets
Exercises use short Python programs to run experiments
Code and solutions hosted on GitHub
caveats: This second edition is no longer current; the third edition is recommended
Print copies are sold through booksellers such as Bookshop.org or Amazon, and the page asks readers to consider supporting Green Tea Press
